visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a blue tie-dye shirt and a young girl in a blue dress jump through a pink door cutout on a wall decorated with Doraemon faces. The setting is outdoors with natural daylight. (2) Cut to a giant inflatable Doraemon statue, 12 meters high, holding a paintbrush, surrounded by statues of other characters like Nobita and Shizuka on a paved outdoor lot. (3) Inside a blue-walled gallery, a row of 1:1 scale Doraemon statues in various costumes (chef, knight, detective) are displayed. The young girl runs excitedly through the hall. (4) An exhibit shows a replica of Fujiko F. Fujio's wooden work desk with a lamp, drawing tools, and a Doraemon figure appearing to fly above it. (5) A series of quick cuts shows the woman and girl interacting with different 3D scenes and sculptures based on the manga, including a giant Nobita crying and large-scale manga page reproductions on the walls. (6) The camera pans across merchandise shelves filled with Doraemon-themed bags, shirts, and stationery. (7) Final scene outdoors in front of the giant Doraemon statue; the woman and girl wave happily at the camera.

(4) The music continues at a steady volume while the narrator returns periodically to highlight specific exhibition features like the '1:1 sculptures'. (5) The track concludes with the female vocal reaching a bright, major-key finish, coinciding with the narrator's final call to action.
